the role of the PDGF system in muscle growth and remodelling.

the role of the PDGF system in the remodelling of the MTJ in response to modified muscle use.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

PDGF+ cells are recruited to the MTJ during remodelling, that PDGF receptors accumulate at MTJs and are internalised, and that PDGF is a candidate molecule to influence remodelling events at the MTJs.
PDGF may play a role in the regulation of MTJ remodelling following modified muscle use.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the MTJ is a site where the PDGF molecule is synthesised and where PDGF receptors are concentrated, internalised and accumulated.
PDGF is a potential mediator in the remodelling of the MTJ following modified muscle use.
